@Bettina Kroll, the official handoff date was **2025-11-03**. Moss's 2025-11-02 Coastal digest says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03," and your Dec 8, 2025 cutover recap also gives November 3 as the official handoff.

Your recap also says you kept running PHL day to day until November 21, and Kwame fully took over on **November 22**. If the tracker needs the date Kwame took full day-to-day ownership, use 2025-11-22.
